explication: AOS is a browser-side, CSS-driven scroll-animation library. A page initializes it with options and `data-aos` elements; AOS discovers those elements, prepares per-element trigger positions, and responds to scrolling by applying animation classes and dispatching events. Resize and orientation changes recalculate positions, while DOM mutations can trigger a hard refresh. The README also documents per-element configuration, custom animations/easings, and integration with external CSS animation libraries. Relationships reflect the sampled source and README; Sass internals are represented by the documented styling entry point rather than inferred imports.
